mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combined effect signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, the combined effect signals a potential economic slowdown with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and FEDFUNDS > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
